headline: Palantine Berm Leads Renewed Front-Line Struggle
war_summary: Since the last edition, Palantine Berm has surged to the fore, recording thirteen strategic-base events in two hours and fifty across the day, with four Colonial, three Warden, and no neutral bases now reported. Weathered Expanse has also flared sharply, posting seven events in two hours and twenty-five in twenty-four; its ledger stands at four Colonial, three Warden, and two neutral. Linn Mercy remains a hard-fought sector, adding five events in the latest two hours and twenty-two for the day, with nine Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base. Marban Hollow has seen eight events in six hours and twenty-eight in the day, while its divided count is five Colonial, one Warden, and two neutral. Nevish Line shows more limited but rising movement, with one event in two hours and eleven daily, and seven Warden against one Colonial base. Mooring County has gone quiet in the latest six hours, though seventeen daily events leave its twelve Warden bases worth watching. The war remains without a declared victor.
